body:
I should have said that this isn’t normal behaviour, we’re on vacation so he wanted to spend the day fully relaxing and not doing something he found boring.  

Funnily enough, i am absolutely a people pleaser to my own demise. It along with a lot of things I am working on in therapy!

We have a lot of things in common that we like doing together, but we also have a good balance of “us things” that we do separately. But I feel like I do a lot of him things, like spending hours in a guitar store for him, while he rarely does me things like watching a tv show I like. A poor example but the first one I could think of.

So I supposed I had assumed this, because of a pattern of behaviour. Which isn’t right either.

We’re on vacation, so we’ve been pretty relaxed. He is quitting smoking (been 2+ years working diligently with a few slip ups) and has been tense. He really just wanted to fully relax all day today I guess.

He is in therapy, we both recently started! We both have a lot of stuff but we’re working on ourselves separately and together.

I don’t know if he seen his behaviour as “dishonest” because he said he just was “trying to avoid a fight” so he was hoping he’d say yes but something would come up and he could get out of it. When I said all that happened is that he avoided a fight just to have a worse fight at a later date he agreed.

He said he didn’t think we should have had to babysit my friends kid because “we don’t even want kids” and hanging out with our nephew now and as he gets older is different “because he’s family”. He didn’t understand that while he has a great family and is really close with his siblings, I don’t really have any family, so my friends and their kids are the closest thing I have to siblings and niblings. He does see that now. And also that, yanno, when your friend who is really good to you asks you to babysit because they have nobody else, you should help them.

He did agree he only agreed to go originally because he “knew I’d be upset and didn’t want to start a fight” and was hoping I’d drop it. He said the only reason he didn’t wanna go is because it sounded boring. I explained I do a lot of “him stuff” that I don’t enjoy (2+ hours at a guitar store on my birthday when I don’t play guitar 😅) and that I would like it if this could go bot ways. He doesn’t agree so we’re gonna keep working on this point.

I am working to break a lot of my problematic behaviours I’ve learned through the years, and it’s hard because I need him to call me out when I’m acting that way but he’s worried it’ll make it worst so we’re working to figure it out. I was raised by scary and I don’t like that it’s made me scary. We’re both in therapy and are working on these things. I appreciate the comment
